scope: Transport-neutral authenticated-user storefront port for grouped notification inbox reads open authorization and group state commands

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

notifications_local_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the owner-local implementation ledger without replacing the large file wholesale

policy.ownership_scope: tenant UUID comes only from PortContext tenant_id and recipient UUID comes only from a user actor id
policy.request_identity_boundary: storefront request DTOs contain no tenant_id or recipient_id fields
policy.actor_boundary: only PortActorKind user may access the storefront inbox port
policy.read_admission: unread count group summaries group items and open authorization require PortCallPolicy read before owner access
policy.write_admission: group-state commands require PortCallPolicy write with deadline and non-empty idempotency key before owner access
policy.write_operations: apply_group_state using mark_read mark_unread or archive
policy.owner_delegation: every operation delegates to an existing Notifications owner service
policy.authorization: group summaries group items and open authorization retain recipient privacy before source target authorization
policy.state_boundary: group writes retain exact state-owner transition timestamp and terminal archive invariants
policy.error_boundary: NotificationError values map to stable sanitized PortError categories without database or provider detail
policy.delivery_boundary: reads and group commands create or change no delivery attempt
policy.transport_boundary: the port is transport-neutral and does not add HTTP GraphQL Leptos server functions or host route registration
policy.ui_boundary: the Notifications storefront continues rendering the explicit unavailable state until a native adapter is composed

not_delivered: Notifications storefront native server function adapter and host composition
